acceptance.line: the adjudication lands in CONTRACTS/ per this track's version discipline, with a back-pointer at theoria-arm GAPS R2-2, and a permanent negative test that demonstrates today's failure and its reason
acceptance.why: Verdict (b) is taken and written as a contract: CONTRACTS/dsl_grammar_v0.4.md, a new file per the track's discipline (a change to what the grammar refuses goes in a new version; the in-place `Correction, DATE` precedent is only for a shortfall the contract had already declared). The negative sample is tests/test_c15_unnameable_cell.py, 30 tests, permanent under (b), asserting the refusal AND its reason in every form that can see it, with the seated positive control and the guard-side legality control that keep it from being read too broadly. NOT MET, and not lowered: the back-pointer at theoria-arm/GAPS.md R2-2 is not applied, because theoria-arm is another territory and this track reads it only. The exact text, hard-wrapped to that file's 76 columns and in its own pointer style, plus a proposed GAP R2-2b for the operator-lever debt, is handed over whole in monitor/inbox/.

delivered.contract: CONTRACTS/dsl_grammar_v0.4.md -- refuses the board-cell extension (GAP R2-2); makes normative the effect-target rule the compiler already enforced in silence; adds, removes and alters no production, so every manual that compiled under v0.3 compiles under v0.4
corrections_to_prior_work: runs/20260801T1200Z-.../FINDING.md:207-211 predicted gen_pddl would still compile a manual that writes a landmark. Measured false: on the cart world, which all four forms compile, all four refuse the edit (PDDL_LEAK.json). Closed by measurement, not by code.

This run's own draft argument was refuted by an adversarial review and rebuilt. The three false premises -- write-extent == instance set in all four forms; option (a)'s design space is empty; the four forms are four independent witnesses -- were each re-run first-hand (COUNTERDESIGN.txt) and are recorded as rejected in v0.4 section 3.6 so the verdict cannot be rebuilt on them.
delivered.cross_territory: monitor/inbox/20260802T085557Z-W-9204-c15-verdict-and-the-gaps-backpointer-theoria-arm-must-paste.md and monitor/inbox/20260802T085557Z-W-9204-freeze-manifest-will-not-hash-dsl-grammar-v0-4.md; no file under theoria-arm/, freeze/ or any other territory was edited
delivered.tests_added: theory-compiler/tests/test_c15_unnameable_cell.py, 30 tests (the refusal with its reason in every form that can see it; all four co-derived forms on a world all four otherwise compile; gen_pddl's two exact reasons pinned; the read/write asymmetry; allocation refused; the seated positive control)
delivered.verdict: (b) -- refuse the extension. Not because it is impossible: a sparse write-time overlay was built and burns the frontier cell with one extra state field and nothing seated. Refused because its bill is a rewrite of `frame persist`, `conflict` and `count(<Type>, ...)`, all of which v0.3 section 1 quantifies over objects; because Theoria.md:226's whole-frame accounting admits no rule-written pixel belonging to neither board nor object, and is an immovable constraint; and because a confirmed edge hypothesis is best read as Theoria.md:43's `looked at the board wrong`, whose repair is re-seating and needs no new syntax.

gaps: R2-2 is re-addressed, not closed. The repair is a seating operator in theoria-arm; whether a seated edge instance converts the recovered predictions into confirmed rules needs a live leg this run did not spend.
The theoria-arm/GAPS.md R2-2 back-pointer is handed over via monitor/inbox/ rather than applied -- another territory.

freeze/build_manifest.py hard-codes the grammar path list, so v0.4 will be silently unhashed in the release manifest until that list gains it. CLAUDE.md's contract table likewise omits v0.4. Both are other territories; asks in monitor/inbox/.
gen_pddl is unmodified. Its agreement with the other three forms is pinned by test, not by structure.

The guard side is legal in three forms, not four: gen_pddl refuses colored(<cell>, n) and free(<landmark>) for a whole world class -- v0.3 section 5's declared pre-existing shortfall, not this clause's business.
The overlay counter-design was measured, not costed. It establishes that option (a)'s design space is non-empty; nobody has priced the semantics rewrite v0.4 section 3.3 names.
